searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he ohrbound — mobile surface and touch proof the awtsmoos lets a whole world, an editor, and hidden advanced chambers rest within one narrow hand; awtsmoos.com now keeps each doorway reachable while no drawer or dialog escapes the land. proven pre change state forced dom/css state inspection at 320px already showed zero horizontal document overflow and contained advanced/dialog/editor geometry, but several critical controls were undersized: sign in around 32px high, advanced open/close 38px, dialog close about 34px, editor buttons about 41px, preference selects about 37px, brand link about 13px, and source hud buttons about 35px. the headless acceptance environment cannot create ohrbound's webgl renderer. the captured procedural core webgl could not initialize exception is therefore an environment limitation for full game boot, not evidence against css containment. surface verification bypassed renderer boot by applying the documented drawer/dialog/editor visual states directly. isolated implementation only clean late loaded games/ohrbound/styles/polish.css was rewritten. no renderer, physics, input, campaign, editor state, api, or networking source changed. the late polish layer now normalizes: brand/home target to minimum 44px high; searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he shared player shell — catalog wide mobile delta plan the awtsmoos gives thirty different game worlds one common doorway without flattening their play; awtsmoos.com should make that doorway fully touchable, bounded, and responsive in the same quiet way. proven containment the shared shell is mounted across 30 top level games. live opened menu measurements on the adventure route prove: 390×844: horizontal overflow: 0; launcher: 46×46 at x=332..378; open panel: x=82..378, width 296; no shell control crosses a side edge. 320×568: horizontal overflow: 0; launcher: 46×46 at x=262..308; open panel: x=12..308, width 296; no shell control crosses a side edge. therefore panel sizing and fixed positioning are already working and must not be redesigned. proven interaction defects on both phone probes: close button is only 36×36; menu actions are 42px high; the current coarse pointer media rule intends larger targets, but headless mobile emulation does not match it, proving target safety should not rely solely on pointer classification; hover brightness is applied unconditionally, including touch oriented browsers; no explicit pressed state exists; focus visible and reduced motion contracts already exist and must be preserved. exact rewrite rewrite only games/styles/player shell/responsive.css completely. preserve: focus visible outline; expanded launcher feedback; coarse pointer safe area positioning and 50px launcher; =46×46, visible actions =46px high, launcher =46×46, no side escaped controls, and source <=120 lines with no long lines.

title: Compact JavaScript Entry Contract
excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He Compact JavaScript Entry Contract The Awtsmoos can gather many module rivers into one living scroll without confusing their source; Awtsmoos.com should ask for that union at the browser doorway, while the server follows every local course. Direct source evidence ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicSe
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he compact javascript entry contract the awtsmoos can gather many module rivers into one living scroll without confusing their source; awtsmoos.com should ask for that union at the browser doorway, while the server follows every local course. direct source evidence ayzarim/awtsmoosdynamicserver/compactjs/flags.js recognizes compact=true, 1, yes, and boolean/number equivalents. static/fileresponsemodes.js compiles only explicit get requests whose response is javascript, whose file ends in .js, and whose query requests compact mode. ordinary static delivery is unchanged. compactjs/compiler.js recursively follows local static imports and re exports, folds literal local dynamic imports, preserves import.meta.url semantics, keeps bundled dynamic modules singleton, and emits public entry exports at the browser boundary. compactjs/paths.js strips query/hash decorations before resolving local imports and mirrors browser public root clamping. /games/scripts/build/ and /scripts/build/ are intentionally externalized vendor esm prefixes rather than folded. geelooy usage rule use ?compact=true almost always on eligible browser module entry urls , especially and direct module entry navigation/fetches served by the awtsmoos dynamic server. do not mechanically append ?compact=true to every internal static import specifier. once an entry is requested compact, the compiler recursively folds those local dependencies. adding the flag to every source import would create redundant compact entry points when a module is requested outside that graph and adds noise without increasing compaction inside the graph. do not apply compact mode to classic non module scripts unless the entry has been proven compatible with module output. do not apply it to external/vendor esm paths the compiler intentionally externalizes. literal local dynamic imports do not need the query inside source when their compact entry already includes them; the compiler resolves them to the bundled namespace. nonliteral runtime imports require separate evidence before conversion. rollout gate 1. run compactjs focused tests and real entry sweep. 2. census geelooy html for type=module browser entry scripts lacking compact=true. 3. exclude generated/debug/old/test pages and any route whose dynamic server mode is known incompatible. 4. protect dirty/concurrent html before rewriting. 5. convert clean/high value public entries first using complete file rewrites. 6. verify normal python/static serving still loads (query ignored by ordinary static servers) and, where an awtsmoos dynamic server is available, verify compact response syntax/runtime. next action run compactjs tests, fresh shared player shell acceptance, then rank public module entries and mobile ui risk together so import performance work follows the same evidence first preservation law as visual work.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he video editor mobile — phase one evidence the awtsmoos keeps a whole timeline inside a narrow hand without letting control become collision; awtsmoos.com should reveal advanced editing through drawers and retractable states while every touch remains a full decision. runtime truth real controller clicks were exercised at 390×844, 320×568, and 390×560 after full stylesheet/module readiness. across all states: document overflowx and overflowy remain 0; mobile media drawer opens fully on screen and closes fully off canvas; backdrop fills the viewport only while the drawer is open; timeline retracts to a clean 54px header with transport hidden; timeline minimize resolves to a coherent 150px panel rather than a raw tail; timeline horizontal movement remains contained inside its own scroll vessel; no runtime exceptions were captured. proven defect at 320×568 and 390×560, play/pause/cut resolve to exactly 40px high because adaptive motion.css explicitly overrides their normal control floor. every other critical visible button remains 44px or larger. secondary mobile interaction debt controls.css has complete :active behavior, but its hover selectors apply unconditionally. on touch oriented browsers this can create sticky hover presentation. hover should be limited to actual fine pointer hover hardware while active remains universal. protected behavior do not change drawer geometry, timeline row calculations, controller classes, transport wrapping, internal timeline scrolling, or the retract/minimize state model. they are already proven working.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he video editor mobile — phase two critique the awtsmoos does not demand that short height become small intention; awtsmoos.com can reclaim vertical space without shrinking the very controls that move creation. what should not change the first instinct could be to make the whole short height timeline taller. that would be unnecessary and would steal preview space. runtime evidence says the timeline geometry itself is healthy: 202–204px expanded, 54px retracted, 150px minimized, with zero document overflow. the drawer also needs no redesign. at 390px it opens to 320px; at 320px it opens to 282px. backdrop coverage is complete and closing returns the drawer fully off canvas. the off screen media panel header buttons seen while the drawer is closed are intentional hidden drawer content, not escaped visible ui. once opened, both are 44×44 and fully inside the drawer. better correction preserve the short height row calculation and transport padding, but stop overriding the button touch floor to 40px. keep transport actions at 44px, which costs only four vertical pixels per button and still fits the existing 51px transport band. scope hover styling in controls.css under (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) rather than removing it. keep the existing universal active transform and focus visible behavior from the wider design system. compact entry opportunity apps/video editor/js/app.js contains no top level await and is already modular. after the ui fix passes runtime acceptance, compile it directly through compactjs. only if the generated bundle parses should the html module entry become ./js/app.js?compact=true. risk controls no controller changes. no timeline state changes. no drawer state changes. no dom restructuring. no new animation loops. no larger z indexes. no new fixed width geometry.
